text:
Emma (Partnerships): Nimbus delivered a follow-up bundle for the marketplace variants (EMEA + APAC). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nimbus_apac_assets
Emma (Partnerships): Included: localized solution brief (EN/JA), a short customer vignette, and updated banners. They note an embargo for the joint PR until next Friday.
Raj (Marketing): Important: embargo. We need to sync PR copy with their comms team. Also confirm pricing blurb for marketplace listing (do we show 'contact sales' or a starting $/mo?). Carlos, what's marketplace guidance?
Carlos (Marketplace PM): For marketplace, we can show 'contact vendor' unless partner gives a standard starting tier. If Nimbus can provide a public starting price we can surface it, but legal usually prefers contact-first.
Mike (Design): Downloading banners. Specs: 1400x560 hero, 300x300 square, 1200x628 social. Their hero PNG has visible compression artifacts. Need SVG or high-res PNG. Also no alt text provided; we should request accessible alt text and short descriptions for marketplace metadata.
Olivia (Partner PM): Pinged Nimbus for vector masters + alt text + short descriptions per locale. Asked for caption for the vignette (30-40 words) and a 1-line tagline for the marketplace card.
nimbus-upload-bot: file uploaded: /assets/nimbus_marketplace_bundle_v2.zip
Liang (Solutions): Quick note on the brief: their architecture diagram references an SI partner (BluePeak) integration flow. Can we get a one-paragraph blurb from our SI enablement lead about expected integration patterns? We shouldn't assume out-of-the-box connectors.
Emma (Partnerships): Good call. @Liang can you loop in the SI lead and draft an integration note we can share with Nimbus? We'll mark it as 'integration patterns' not a certified connector.
Liang (Solutions): Yep, I'll draft a neutral note and share by EOD.
Sarah (Legal): Reviewing files for trademark and claims. Two red flags: 1) vignette uses a customer's logo without permission (they said 'customerX' but image uses the live logo) 1) brief includes the phrase 'data never leaves country X' in JA version which implies a hosting guarantee. Please remove or qualify.
Mike (Design): I'll remove the logo from the vignette image and request Nimbus do the same in their original. Also I'll prepare alt text and ARIA-friendly descriptions for each locale.
Raj (Marketing): Messaging ask: for co-brand headline let's avoid 'enterprise-grade' again. Propose: 'Production-grade inference for regulated workloads' for headline variants targeted at marketplace. Straightforward and matches our product positioning.
Olivia (Partner PM): Nimbus replied: they can replace the vignette image and remove the country-hosting phrase. They also provided a 1-line tagline (EN): "Low-latency inference, built for production." They asked if that's ok.
Emma (Partnerships): Slight tweak: change 'built for production' to 'for production workloads' so it aligns with our phrasing. I'll propose that back to Nimbus.
Carlos (Marketplace PM): Also need a 75-120 char summary and a longer 400-600 char description. We should localize those for JA; Nimbus offered translation but Legal needs to sign off first.
Sarah (Legal): I'll review translations but need explicit confirmation from Nimbus that translations are accurate and approved by their comms team. Also confirm customer quote permissions if any quote was translated.
Mike (Design): Uploaded a cleaned banner set (SVG + optimized PNG) and an accessibility sheet with alt text examples: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cleaned_banners
nimbus-upload-bot: file uploaded: /assets/redwood_nimbus_cleaned_banners_v1.zip
Raj (Marketing): I'll take the 75-char and 400-char drafts and push them through tone check. If Legal clears translations, we can localize copy by tomorrow.
Liang (Solutions): Sent draft integration paragraph to BluePeak and SI lead. Waiting on one small technical accuracy check.
Emma (Partnerships): Checklist: 
- get vector masters + alt text (Olivia)
- confirm vignette image removal/permission (Olivia/Sarah)
- finalize headline + 75/400 char descriptions (Raj)
- legal signoff on translations and customer permissions (Sarah)
- integration note for SI mention (Liang)
- marketplace assets upload and QA (Mike/Carlos)
Carlos (Marketplace PM): Target handoff to marketplace CMS by Tuesday COB to meet our Friday go-live. Need final approved assets by Tuesday noon ideally.
Olivia (Partner PM): Nimbus committed to provide final vectors and confirmation on customer permissions by Monday. Pushing them for early Monday.
Sarah (Legal): I'll block an hour Monday morning to review everything. If I find content that implies guarantees (hosting, residency, SLAs) we request removal or a clarifying footnote.
Mike (Design): Noted. I'll run a final QA for responsive crops and color contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA) before upload.
Emma (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll reconvene Tuesday at 11:00 for final pre-launch sync unless something pops up earlier. Marking this thread for updates. :rocket:
